text:
mira: ACME follow-up: they want per-route monthly spend caps + tenant model pinning + tiered latency SLAs. want pilot in ~6 weeks. is MVP realistic?

alex: boil it down: policy surface, gateway enforcement (estimate + fallback), telemetry/audit, UI for ops/sales. avoid billing backend for MVP.

sam: gateway plan: estimate tokens from input length -> expected_cost = tokens * model_rate. if expected_cost > available_cap -> try fallbacks -> if none, return a clear error.

joan: product idea: tiny "Routing Profile" object customers attach to routes: name, preferred_model, monthly_cost_cap_cents, p95_latency_ms, fallback_sequence, pin_model_version. keep schema minimal.

joan: example: {name:"platinum", preferred_model:"rw-large-v2", monthly_cost_cap_cents:200000, p95_latency_ms:300, fallback:["rw-medium-v2"], pin_model_version:true}

ben: risks: metrics cardinality (tenant x route x profile), estimator accuracy, and billing disputes. mitigation: pilot limits (3 profiles/tenant), sampled telemetry for low tiers, and per-invocation audit events retained 90d.

tess: sales wants a demoable pilot. model pinning is a must. theyll provide sample prompts for the simulator.

legal-bot: NOTE: "Pilot SLAs are non-contractual." Legal must approve external messaging before demos.

alex: MVP scope: API/Console CRUD for profiles, gateway enforcement hooks, telemetry + dashboards, sales simulator, pilot guardrails (profile limits, sampling). no hard billing blocks.

sam: schedule estimate: 1wk spike + 2w infra + 1w console + 1w QA = ~5wks, add 1wk buffer for legal/sales.

joan: launch criteria: pilot region supports target load, p95 under target for platinum, per-profile cost dashboard + alerts, rollback toggle to disable profiles globally.

ben: ops: provide an "ops override" for emergency unpin/fallback; cap profiles and cardinality sampling.

mira: actions: @sam spike & branch, @joan schema + mockups, @ben infra estimate, @tess gather sample prompts, @mira coordinate legal & pilot SOW. meeting Thurs 9am to finalize.

deploy-bot: branch created: feature/cost-aware-routing (by sam). PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/4410

sam: ack. will post spike notes EOD tomorrow. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
